comparison.objective: Select and insert a PH2 hex bit into an electric screwdriver holder.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize the tool, grasp the correct bit, align a close-clearance hexagonal shank, and push it to depth.
comparison.success_condition: PH2 bit seated at least 9 mm with submillimetre and angular tolerances, released, and arms withdrawn; falling objects fail. No separate spec version is present.
comparison.reason: Hexagonal insertion and stabilization overlap at a primitive level, but this record tests close-clearance component insertion; the candidate tests recessed fastener operation, torque-limited locking, and iterative dynamic adjustment.
